summary: Microsoft and 2K's freeride snowboarding trilogy; use original Xbox/Xemu for the first two entries and Xbox 360 hardware or compatible preservation for Amped 3.

emulation.notes: Original hardware best preserves hard-drive soundtrack behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox or high-resolution Xbox emulation

primary.why: The first Amped is an Xbox-only launch title built around full-mountain freestyle runs and the Xbox hard drive's custom soundtrack support.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or Xemu if compatible, using custom soundtrack support only where the platform route preserves it.

entries.title: Amped 2
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox release with preserved online route if desired

emulation.emulator: Xemu / original Xbox hardware / Insignia for online preservation
emulation.notes: Original hardware plus Insignia is the preservation route for online play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox or high-resolution Xbox emulation

primary.why: Amped 2 is an Xbox-only sequel with split-screen, System Link, Xbox Live-era online design, custom soundtracks, and snow-skate content.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or Xemu if compatible; use Insignia only for community-restored online play.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Xbox release with split-screen, System Link, and Xbox Live-era online modes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original Xbox Live was shut down in 2010; replacement online servers can restore some online functionality, but that is a preservation route rather than the original service.

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware is the reliable route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Xbox 360 output or accurate Xbox 360 emulation

primary.why: Amped 3 is an Xbox 360-only finale with no documented PC or modern port; the original Xbox 360 release is the preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a compatible Xbox 360 preservation/emulation setup if it accurately runs the game.
